summary: Full E2E test of AI Opportunities & Recommendations sprint. Backend 8/8 pytest passed (list shape+sort, item fields, brief, health w/ 6 categories, dismiss/snooze persistence, archive-project + 404, org isolation). Frontend: /login demo → dashboard shows daily-brief (greeting+lines+view-all), workspace-health (77% Good), dashboard-opportunities; sidebar Opportunities nav present; /opportunities page renders 6 cards with all required testids (opportunity-priority, opportunity-action-btn, opportunity-dismiss-btn), score rings, filter chips with counts (All 6, Critical 0, High 0, Medium 2, Low 3 — filter narrows list correctly, High shows 0 cards as expected). Snooze removes card immediately and persists across reload. One-click actions work: 'Open client' navigates to /clients; 'Set a deadline' navigates to /projects/{id}?tab=overview. Assistant priming via /projects/{id}?tab=proposal&assist=improve opens the floating assistant-panel primed with project context. Regression: /dashboard, /ai-workspace, /ai-chat all render without errors; no 'Maximum update depth exceeded' loops observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Assistant auto-run on ?assist=improve requires the project to already have a proposal document; on the fresh demo (proposal not yet generated) the panel opens & is primed but the improve command silently no-ops. Consider showing a subtle 'Generate proposal first' hint when primed action has no target document.
opportunities.py is 343 lines and still readable — fine now but if more rule types are added consider splitting rules into per-domain modules.
test_credentials: Explore Demo btn on /login; token stored under localStorage key 'assistify_token'
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo seed (Northwind Labs / Vertex Studio / Halcyon Group clients; Q3 Marketing Site / Brand Redesign projects; 6 opportunities, health 77%)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_23 (Opportunities) fully passing. LocalStorage token key is 'assistify_token' (not 'accessToken'). Demo seeds Medium×2 project_no_deadline + Low×3 client_missing_info + 1 client_not_contacted = 6 opps; no High/Critical in seed. To exercise assist priming end-to-end with an LLM run, generate a proposal first on a demo project, then hit /projects/{id}?tab=proposal&assist=improve.
